d:
The Bucks defeated the Raptors, 116-111 tonight in Toronto. Tyler Herro finished with a team-high 32 points along with 8 assists and 6 rebounds for the Bucks, while Myles Turner tallied 27 points, 11 rebounds and 5 three pointers in the game. Scottie Barnes recorded 31 points, 8 assists and 5 rebounds. The Bucks improve their record to 2-16 with the win, while the Raptors fall to 6-11 for the season.
